analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM & Weinstein Stage Analysis

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Developing a double-bottom pattern above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 on 1.49x volume. Volatility contraction shows base stabilization, but relative strength lags true market leaders.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Operating margins remain depressed at ~1.5%-3.0% with revenue plunging -55.3% YoY. A modest net profit of ₹1.02 Cr is weighed down by weak interest coverage and a meager 3-year average ROE of 3.1%, failing CANSLIM's fundamental threshold.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: Thesis invalidates on a close below 104.11 support; Minervini discipline requires an immediate exit to curb downside.

AARON.technical: Stage 2 advance clearing a 20-session high on 1.21x volume. Aligned swing lows formed solid neckline support, while positive MACD momentum confirms steady accumulation without short-term exhaustion.
AARON.fundamental: Robust earnings acceleration with Q2 PAT surging 107% YoY and revenue rising 21.9%. ROCE of 18.7%, ROE of 15.0%, and 73.1% promoter backing reflect solid execution. October sales reached a record ₹11.66 Cr.
AARON.risk: Violation of the 134.59 swing low breaches the 20-day breakout base, triggering a rapid stop-loss to conserve trading capital.

AARTIDRUGS.technical: Textbook SEPA breakout clearing a 20-session high fueled by massive 23.57x average volume. Price is firmly above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 with MACD confirmation, demonstrating exceptional institutional accumulation.
AARTIDRUGS.fundamental: Exceptional quarter featuring record revenue of ₹829 Cr (+26.6% YoY) and an 83% PAT surge to ₹82.8 Cr. EBITDA margins expanded 370 bps to 16.6% as formulations leaped 58% on export demand, satisfying CANSLIM C and A criteria.
AARTIDRUGS.risk: Pattern fails if price falls below the 441.76 pivot stop; swift execution prevents capital erosion in a weak market environment.

ABCAPITAL.technical: Emerging from a constructive Stage 2 base, clearing a 20-session high above key moving averages (EMA21, SMA50, SMA200). MACD is positive, and RSI of 72 reflects strong momentum without excessive extension.
ABCAPITAL.fundamental: Lending AUM expanded 32% YoY to ₹2.34 lakh Cr while Housing Finance AUM jumped 50%, powering a 38% net profit surge and 31% top-line growth. Asset quality improved with Stage 2/3 loans down to 2.31%, underpinning institutional sponsorship.
ABCAPITAL.risk: A reversal below the 391.92 stop breaches key EMA21 support, negating the breakout thesis and forcing loss curtailment.

ABDL.technical: Reclaimed its rising 21-EMA with a bullish pivot candle following a double-bottom pullback near highs. RSI at 59 indicates constructive momentum, though volume requires sustained expansion to power the advance.
ABDL.fundamental: Top-line growth of 15.9% YoY was supported by record festive volumes, but supply-chain friction compressed margins, leaving PAT growth at 9.7% YoY. Elevated debt and single-digit profit growth miss CANSLIM's 25% earnings hurdle.
ABDL.risk: Breakdown below 712.35 violates swing low and 21-EMA support, requiring immediate defensive liquidation under Minervini rules.

ABSLBANETF.technical: Banking ETF clearing a 20-session resistance level on 1.44x volume expansion. Supported by aligned swing lows and positive MACD trajectory, though relative strength tracks the broader financial index rather than idiosyncratic leadership.
ABSLBANETF.risk: A fall below 58.68 invalidates the 20-day breakout structure; strict risk protocol demands an immediate exit.
